title: Oh My G!
description: Sophie Cepeda is a teenager who struggles after both her parents died. Sophie blamed God for the loss of her loved ones, until God himself appears to Sophie in different forms to enlighten the latter on the obstacles she is facing.

title: I Remember When I Die
description: If the human concept of time ceases at the moment of death, is it then physically possible to experience eternity? Can we affect this last moment in life? Can we build our own eternity? 'I Remember When I Die' takes partly place at life's last destination, a hospice - and is partly shot in a land of memories and provocative choices. We meet the patients, their stand-ins and their dreams. Death is a process. Not black and white. If you could hold on to a memory forever, which one would it be? A highly original journey into the mystery of consciousness.

Romeo is adamant to keep on seeing Giulietta while keeping clear of Felice, while Felice is forcing other suitors onto his sister that are more to his liking.

title: And I Ride and I Ride
description: Musician and Kat Onoma band leader until 2004, Rodolphe Berger lives as if he had nine lives. He's had many determining if paradoxical meetings, with artists or fameless and workless characters, to the point of sabotaging himself sometimes. He kept on going no matter what, transfiguring rock music, mixing his own intimate story with some history of music, a story of people with a story of places. He kept going towards a destination he didn't necessarily want to know about. We only know where his home bases are: Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines, Paris, Batz Island. We only know that it all stems from something - that his personal path took him from philosophy to music.

title: Oli i doxa... Oli i hari...
I Didn't Know I Was Pregnant
description: Women, who never knew they were pregnant, give birth.

title: I gaar og i morgen
description: Director Albrechtsen (Johannes Meyer) is a harsh and ruthless businessman who will not shy away from anything that makes money. One day it is too much for his skilled and indispensable employee Humlegaard (Ejner Federspiel). He leaves the company in anger, and it soon dawns on the brutal director that he cannot do without Humlegaard. However, the director's actions have already made him such a despised person that Humlegaard is not the only one putting his foot down.

title: I Do, I Don't
description: A documentary about love, marriage, and what happens when the realities of modern day life collide with the biblical ideals by which some 174 million Americans are trying to live their lives.

title: I fantastici 5
description: An emotional story about the sporting activities, difficulties, passions and relationships of a group of disabled athletes and their coach.

title: Zatch Bell! [Hindi]
description: Kiyo Takamine meets a momoto (demons from another world) boy zatch bell and set out to compete in the momoto games held every 1000 years to become their king.

title: I Loved, I Bled, I Let Go
description: Frankie, a musical prodigy, sacrificed everything to make his wife Sophie a star, only to be cast aside like a forgotten melody.Betrayed and broken, he died in obscurity—until he awoke twenty years in the past. This time, he'll harness his genius for himself, ascending to heights Sophie could never imagine. As his symphonies dominate the world, she and their kids, who have forgotten him, are left with a haunting question:Was their betrayal worth losing a legend?

title: I, Predator
description: It has taken millions of years for predatory animals to develop the skills required to take down their prey and I, PREDATOR takes viewers inside their bodies while they're on the hunt. Learn how the Great White, the Cheetah, the Polar Bear and more are able to successfully stalk, attack and concur their prey.

title: I Know I Love You [Hindi]
description: Xu Nuo, a florist, meets a veterinary doctor, Zhao Jin, serendipitously, when both are at a crossroads in their lives and decide to stay platonic friends. They however struggle to deny how they fill the missing parts of each other's lives.

title: K Chyornomu moryu
description: Pretty Irina Kruchinina learns her first year at a pedagogical university. The teacher of the same institute, Konstantin Aleksandrovich, is not indifferent to her and suggests to go in the summer together to the Black Sea on the new "Volga".

title: K.
description: A documentary about a less privileged boy whom at a young age started reaching out to street children who are less fortunate like him.

title: Chelovek K
description: The main character, which is a prototype of Kafka, is on his way to achieving true self-cognition. The impetus for this was vague childhood memories associated with emotions, as well as the identification of his identity with certain images at that period. He is facing an internal conflict, tearing him apart, between creativity and reality that are not compatible with each other.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
description: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

title: Dickie K.
description: 1980s NYC: Reagan says "Just say no," Koch asks "How am I doin'?", and a drug addict in his twenties is confronted with two choices: dying by the monkey sitting on his shoulder or accepting the help of his family and a new chance to reach his full potential.

title: Anna K

title: Anna K.
description: Joana suffers from a double personality and is obsessed with Anna Karenina, the character from Tolstoy's novel. Embodying the myth of Narcissus, Anna K. is the image and resemblance of Joana, stronger and more seductive.

"Mama/M.A.M.A." is the provocative investigation of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy, a perplexing psychological disorder where a mother secretly but deliberately harms her child in order to get the sympathy and praise of others and the attention of the medical community. What emerges over three years of scrutiny are disturbing questions related to the medical profession's arrogant use of the diagnosis, the possible contribution from the pharmaceutical industry, and its grievous impact on families. Questions addressed in this film include: Is this syndrome an authentic phenomenon or is it a witch hunt? What are the moral implications of a society that fails to question the science behind the disorder, blindly lending faith to its sensational existence? The deeply disturbing "Mama/M.A.M.A." closely follows three cases, allowing the audience to absorb all points of view and determine who the real abusers are. (Florida Film Festival)

description: Set four years after the Portuguese revolution and the simultaneous loss of the Portuguese empire in Africa, the story concerns a director who sells guns to finance his play.

title: O-Parts
description: In the year 2141, Japan successfully builds a basic time machine that can send data to the past. However, an evil organization further develops the technology, making it possible to send objects back in time as well. The organization begins a plan to send 5 terrorists back to the year 2012 in order to assassinate the ancestor of an important person from their time. The future government, alerted to this fact, uses its time machine to notify the government of 2012 about the plot, telling them to recruit 5 people in order to seek out the terrorists.

title: O Predileto
description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: O Arrependimento é o Castigo
description: Karen é dona de casa e casada com Tom, um advogado rico. Enquanto trai o marido, sua casa pega fogo e a filha, Anna, de cinco anos, cai do andar de cima. A pequena é resgatada por Merry e levada por um caminhão dos bombeiros ao hospital. No caminho, o veículo colide com o carro de Karen. Sem saber que a menina ferida é sua filha, Karen exige desculpas e indenização — e atrasa a única chance de salvar Anna.

title: O, schastlivchik!
description: Recently, Slavik has started to question the meaning of life and he has not found a positive or satisfactory answer. On the brink of suicide and about to end it all, Slavik is offered a chance to alter the outcome of his life.

title: O Kadin
description: The film is about the life of a fashion designer who had a tragedy in her childhood.

title: O Milionário
description: A sentimental comedy about toothpicks. A man makes and exchanges toothpicks for numerous products as he ignores money. He is called "The millionaire" and goes through the city, walking, meeting friends, Carlitos, the newspaper seller, and Celeste the lemon seller and living an innocent life, in contrast with the city, filled with traps.

title: O tsarlatanos
description: An immigrant in Germany works hard to be able to live his family in Greece. When eventually forced to return, he discovers that he hasn't a damn, because the bank has bankrupted. So returns hidden in a car-fridge and arrives frozen.

title: O trellopenintaris
description: A failed businessman who accepts to pose as a rich ship owner to break into high-end social circles, falls for a wealthy widow, unbeknownst to him that his official fiancée is not prepared to lose him. Will she bring him to his senses?

title: O ouranokatevatos
description: Yearning to see his beloved family one last time to lend them a helping hand, a recently deceased paterfamilias asks dear God for a leave of absence; however, their scandalous misbehaviour is shocking. Can he help them get back on track?

title: O Pseftothodoros
description: Theodoros comes to Greece from abroad. They welcome him friends and relatives, wanting his fortune.

title: O apithanos
description: Thomas, the owner of an electrical appliances store, is having business problems due to his short-fuse temper and bad luck.

title: O Acidente
description: The cyclist Joana is involved in an odd accident, where she is carried on the hood of a car for a block. Joana leaves unharmed and decides to hide this incident from her partner, Cecilia. When a strange video of the accident comes to light, Joana's omission is exposed. She gradually starts to get involved in the life of the family of the person who hit her.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon?

title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, may kakaibang dictionary!
description:
Mula sa iconic na “Jumbo Hotdog” at “Sana Mama” na minsang nagpaindak sa buong nation, nagbabalik to flex their muscles and new single ang grupong Masculados. Grateful ang grupo na makabalik at mabigyan ng pagkakataong ipagpatuloy ang kanilang musika.

Hindi lang ganda ang puhunan, dapat may wit na panlaban. Dahil bawat tanong, kailangang may sagot na papalakpakan ng buong bayan. Kaya naghanda ng matitinding linyahan ang mga Miss Q and A candidates na nagharapan.

Ready magbigay ng tutorial sa ganda at talino ang online tutor na si Precious Alden Ganaden, habang mula pageant coaching ay siya naman ngayon ang sasabak sa sariling laban, si MJ Apin Salada. Naaliw naman ang Madlang People, pati na si Vice Ganda, sa kakaibang dictionary ni Ivanach.

Sa second round na Wit Lang, sina MJ at Ivanach ang nagharap. Sinubok si Ivanach sa tanong na, “Kung lechon ka, mao-offend ka ba kung balat lang ang habol sa ’yo samantalang full package ka naman?” Si MJ naman, napaisip kunngmagtatampo ba ang king cobra kung hindi siya ang king of the jungle.

Ayusin ang display at siguraduhing kumpleto ang stocks at siguruhing available ang swerte. Mula sa pag-aasikaso ng mga produktong mabenta, saglit munang iniwan ng mga merchandisers mula NCR ang kanilang puwesto para subukang i-checkout ang POT money sa “Laro Laro Pick."

Kinilala ng hosts si player Frank, ang loving hubby and addy na baon sa utang. Kaya naman si Tyang Amy Perez, to the rescue bitbit ang payo niyang wais. Love life naman ang usapan nang kanilang lapitan si pplayer Yong, na dinamayan ng hosts matapos malamang hiwalay na sila ng kanyang girlfriend.

Kay Frank talaga napunta ang swerte dahil siya ang umabot sa Jackpot Round! Pero imbes na isugal ang lahat para sa ₱450,000 POT, pinili niyang tanggapin ang ₱35,000 Li-Pot offer para may siguradong maipambayad sa kanyang maraming utang.

SexBomb Jopay, sumali sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Napahugot ang madlang people sa pagbisita ng bandang Mayonnaise at sa kanilang performance ng “Bakit, Pt. 2.” 'Nag-spread' din sila ng good vibes nang makisabay sa trending “Meme” dance challenge!

Ang kandidata na mabagal sa pindutan at waley sa talakan, siya naman ang uuwing luhaan. Buti na lang palaban at ginalingan nina "Miss Q and A" JC Ibale, Anxji Rose, at Bon Joey Trinidad.

Habang kinikilala ng hosts ang tatlong ladies, pagandahan din sila ng mga joke entries. Ang starting lineup ay sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro, pero 'di nagtagal, si Vhong ang unang napatalsik dahil sa joke niyang not-so matinik. First substitution of the day!

Chance na rin ito ng ibang hosts na sumabak sa "Miss Q and A." Maya-maya pa, nasubok naman ang husay ni Teddy Corpuz. Pero hindi pa man nagsisimula ang banter, parang may "issue" detected agad. Biro ni Meme, huwag gumigilid-glid si Teddy dahil baka magreklamo ito sa blocking, tapos ang netizens umariba na naman sa bashing.

Back to the pageant, unang pumaslak sa next round si JC, habang sina Anxji at Bon Joey ay nagbangayan tungkol sa "eulogy." Kaloka, mga teh! Pero pagkatapos ng mahabang diskusyon, si Bon Joey ang umabante sa Wit Lang at tumalak sa harap ng buong nation.

Kapag swerte ang bumagsak, huwag manghihina. Baka jackpot ang naghihintay sa players mula Marikina! POT money kaya ay maiuuwi nila?

Mukhang may dalang swerte talaga kapag ikaw ang first interviewee, dahil madalas, sa jackpot round, sila rin ang umaabante. Araw talaga ito ni Emon dahil siya ang naglaro sa POT o Li-POT round.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nangakong babalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Crown of Thorns
description: By the director of Cabinet of Dr.Caligari, this is the Passion embedded in a contemporary story. An anarchist jailed for an attempted assassination is told the Passion story by the prison chaplain, who seeks to convince him that it is better to sacrifice ones own life than take the life of ones enemy. The framing story, taken from a novel, is believed to have been intended to give the Biblical story an anti-Bolshevist propaganda function. In any case, it was added without the knowledge of the actors in the Passion story, who included some of the major stars of the period Asta Nielsen as Mary Magdalene, Henny Porten as Mary, Grigori Chmara as Jesus, and Werner Krauss as Pontius Pilate -bampfa.berkeley.edu

title: Fart: The Movie
description: Russell has two passions: watching television and farting! He also loves Heather. Heather HATES farting. The eternal triangle! One day she warns him, "if they ever allow farting on television, you'll never leave the house!" One evening he goes to sleep in front of the TV, and "it" happens. Virtually everything on TV is fart related, from sitcoms and commercials, to newscasts and dramas.

title: S Is for Sexy
description: Seven Sexy and Smart Short Gay Films: Serene Hunter (France) Set in Paris, the 'hunter' of the title is a 30-something gay male who has a string of one-night stands. Content being free and unfettered by relationships, he happily moves from encounter to encounter. He then surprises himself by becoming involved in a more substantial relationship...but can the hunter within him be tamed? An honest portrayal, with some explicit action. Solace (US) This film shows an older and younger man who meet on the internet, and seem to get along well, until the older man tells about his boyfriend and it shatters younger man's dreams. Scarred (UK) An early 20s male has a significant scar on his face from a knife wound - and is fed up of the unwanted attention that it attracts. Will he find someone who can see past the scar? The answer may lie with an older, middle-aged architect, who seems to be the one person to whom the scar is invisible. Signage (US) Middle age can be hidden somewhat with makeup and hair coloring, which encourages two best friends to plan a night out at a bar that caters to young men half their age. One makes a strong connection with a young deaf guy, only to find out that there is more than one type of obstacle involved. Mr_Right_22 (Germany) First-date jitters in the age of internet dating but a kind waiter calms his fears and offers some encouragement to be open to life's opportunities. Cute. 41 Seconds (Germany) Two masculine friends take about "41 Seconds" to compare notes on one of their dates, in which his girlfriend compared their respective skills as a kisser. Only 4 minutes, but cute. Shahram and Abbas (Netherlands) Two Iranian refugees, a young student activist and an older journalist, who want to see political asylum in the Netherlands. Believing they have a better chance of being granted such if they claim to be a persecuted homosexual couple, they begin a charade that leads to complications they never imagined, especially when the younger Shahram falls for a woman also awaiting asylum. Powerful and positive depiction of a very sad and serious situation.

title: Making Sh*t Up
description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. Includes detailed on-site action at art installations and performances, with spirited opinions from celebrated artists and art world professionals about measuring the success and value of conceptual art.

The film is narrated with spirited, candid commentary by important artists and art professionals such as legendary conceptual / performance artists Marina Abramovic and Vito Acconci on the highs and lows of a conceptual art world with uniquely difficult career choices, by famed New York Magazine Senior Art Critic Jerry Saltz on what is and isn't conceptual art and how Rodriguez measures up, author Steven Henry Madoff about Rodriguez service aesthetics achievements, and celebrated New York art blogger C-Monster.net, who experienced the artist, face- to-face and alone, locked inside his therapy cube.

title: Twarza w twarz
description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

title: The W Plan
description: A British spy helps prisoners of war destroy Germans' secret tunnels.

title: Dr. W
description: Now you are in the domains of magic and fantasy! You are surrounded by the wonders of life and you can ask as many questions as you want! You're on the Dr. W Show! Are you afraid? Are you tired? Alone? Bored??? Have you lost your faith??? Dr. W is here and has something for everyone; No matter if you are small as a microbe or as big as the universe, fast as lightning or slow as evolution, you will get something amazing! Really surprising! So try not to get too excited, try not to laugh and shout very loudly, because what you are about to see is something that you have not seen before. Welcome ... this is the Dr. W Show! Dr. Woody Bonepecker, aka Dr. W, is a delirious doctor who is always looking for the truth of the natural facts of everyday life. He is the presenter of a TV program, and in each episode he will explain to the audience different phenomena in his particular, ironic and hilarious style. Dr. W is really stubborn, he is not afraid of anything and will do anything necessary to get to the bottom of things. In his show, Dr. W uses all kinds of resources to present and explain the topics. Not only does he perform crazy experiments as a good scientist, he also appeals to the most absurd humor as if he were a clown, or to the most fantastic magic as if he were a magician. Dr. W also has the help of special guests in many episodes, as well as an enormous variety of characters that appear to help him in the development of each theme. Likewise, the live audience has a fundamental role, as it reacts to the explanations of Dr. W at all times.

title: Zabawa w chowanego

title: 100 Days My Prince [Hindi]
description: Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner's life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon's oldest bachelorette.

title: The Great W
description: In a post-apocalyptic setting, comic book fanatic Winston sets out to save a captured Deadmen operative named Emily. His spontaneous decision out of boredom gets him involved in the middle of a faction rivalry.

title: Aard W Talab
description: "The series follows intersecting lives under pressure, led by Heba, a schoolteacher who struggles to support her family, care for her brother with disabilities, and save her sick mother."

title: S.W.A.T.
description: Follows the life of Sergeant Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson born and raised in Los Angeles, as he faces conflict between his loyalty to the streets and his colleagues in the force, especially after being assigned to lead the S.W.A.T. unit, which is the last stop to combat crime in LA.

title: Lato w Byszewach
description: Film adaptation of a short story by Jaroslaw Iwaszkiewicz. The action of the film takes place, among others, in the manor house in Byszewy near Lodz, to which the writer first came in June 1911.

title: Abnaa w Qatalah
description: When Shaikhon marries Dalal, a belly dancer. He steals Dalal's money to buy the club where she works. Dalal gets back at him and reports him to the police who have him imprisoned. He comes out of prison full of vengeance.

title: W domu
description: Spring 2020, Poland. 16 filmmakers create 14 short films about unexpected experience of isolation caused by pandemic.

title: F.T.W.
description: Frank T. Wells has just been released from prison after serving a term for manslaughter. Frank's a reasonably honest man and a good rodeo rider. When he meets up with Scarlett, a bank robber on the run, his whole life changes.

title: W pustyni i w puszczy
description: Fourteen year old Polish boy Stas Tarkowski and eight year old Nel Rawlison from England are kidnapped as the hostages by Arabic fanatics and taken to their religion leader. Then they manage to escape and try to return to their fathers. Children have a lot of dangerous adventures, meet two Black kids; Kali and Mea, who also help them, make a friendship with an elephant and help one Black's tribe. Finally they manage to return. Based on great novel, the same title by Nobel receiver (for all his literary output) Henryk Sienkiewicz.

title: W klatce
description: Fire changes the life of a dull lonely bank cashier into a hero. He gets the woman he has always dreamt of. But, considering his modesty and peculiarity, will they really be happy together?

title: Bill W.
description: A documentary about Bill Wilson, the co-founder of Alcoholics Anonymous.

title: Saint X

title: X² - Double X
description: A series of music videos to promote the anime 'X'.

title: Serrat y Sabina: el símbolo y el cuate
Barridos y regados
description: Two men bring a message to a manager in an office with two beautiful secretaries. The manager thinks they are the specialists he is waiting for. They see the opportunity to make Money and to conquest the women. So they go through different challenges untill the real specialists arrive.

title: Donramon y Perchita
description: Online series about the adventures of DonRamon and Perchita

title: Cocolos y Rockeros
description: This documentary examines the musical tastes of Puerto Rico's youth. The terms "cocolos" refers to those who prefer "salsa" music, and "rockeros" to those who prefer "rock" music. Through interviews and an array of musical settings the film explores the young people's feelings in a humorist yet serious manner, bringing to the forefront issues of biases and national identity inherent in this innocent yet very powerful form of social entertainment. Includes musical performances by Gilberto Santa Rosa, El Gran Combo, REO Speedwagon and others.

title: Carne y arena
description: Based on true accounts, the superficial lines between subject and bystander are blurred and bound together, allowing individuals to walk in a vast space and thoroughly live a fragment of the refugees' personal journeys.

title: 70 Y Pico
description: Grandpa, why did they try to kill you? The documentary addresses the animic changes that the filmmaker experiences while he tries to understand the participation that his grandfather played, as a civil associate, during the last military dictatorship in Argentina. The role that he played as the Dean of the Architecture Faculty at the University of Buenos Aires, as a link with the concentration camp ESMA, is one of the multiple topics that grandpa "Pico" narrates in camera.

title: Perros y Diablos
description: A bank robbery goes wrong, and Cobra is the only one who served time for it. 10 years later, those involved reunite to celebrate his release from prison, but things have changed, and the new gathering of friends turns out to be different.

title: Nacional y Popular
description: The life's story and militancy of the members of the Cooperative of stream's cleaning New Hope and Progress, formed by young and (and not such much) militants of the Movimiento Evita in Malvinas Argentinas , a Gran Buenos Aires town The work in the river, the activities in the district and discussion panels is the starting point, so that the companions can analyze the Conjunture of their political process and the roll that militancy and working class play today. From 2001's Crisis, to the triumph of Cristina Kirchner in the national elections, happening through the Town or Corporations discussion Resolution 125 generated, the negative mass media vision of the citizen protest, to the Nestor Kirchner's funeral the documentary recalls the Won and Lost Battle s this last eight years and the way to consolidate a nation for all.

title: Música y dinero
description: Empleados amenazan con iniciar una huelga y el jefe le pide ayuda a un amigo cantante que ha recibido una herencia.

title: Y+
description: A series of sketches about the miseries of life in the 21st century and its effects on the human condition.

title: Ayer y hoy
description: Two women from the same family, one from 1830 and the other from 1930, the first subject to the rigor of the customs of her time and the other in an atmosphere of independence and freedom.

title: Porn and Ice Cream
description: Two socially-awkward thirty-somethings and a young con woman start a rock band that takes the Buenos Aires music scene by storm.

description: The purchase of a fridge (a huge investment then) is a pretext to show the joys and hardships of a traditional Cuban family in the 50s. Extremely funny.

title: Pobol y Cwm
description: A Welsh-language TV soap (the longest running BBC television soap) set in the small Welsh town of Cwmderi, in the heart of the South Wales valleys.

title: Fulano y Mengano
description: The stay in the prison of Eudosio and Carlos, accused unjustly, prevents them from getting a job when they go free. As much as they intend to explain that they were locked up for no reason, nobody will listen to them. So they decide to steal to stay alive. His house is a whole building in ruins, without any closed window and with the walls that are barely standing. Esperanza will try to turn that space into a home, where she works with enthusiasm. But life is very hard and coexistence is also difficult.

title: Y que patatín, y que patatán
description: Five episodes that reflect a critical look on the universe of children. An ironic metaphor about the training of children and how they respond to limiting situations in their lives.

title: Amor y Mentira
description: Andrea, una universitaria, quedó embarazada de Mario, quien fingió ser pobre por una apuesta. Al ser "condenado a muerte" (él era en realidad el Señor de la Guerra), Andrea se hizo cantante para salvarlo. Al descubrir la verdad, usó una máscara; Mario, sin reconocerla, la humilló. Demasiado tarde, entendió su error.

title: Kava z Kardamonom
description: Lviv, at the dawn of the nineteenth century. Young Anna is living a simple life, helping her uncle in the bakery, while her brother is in the seminary. Yet, Anna dreams of something much grander: true, mutual love. Her family has a different idea for her. She is supposed to marry the wealthy tradesman Marykan - and while he is in love with her, she cannot muster the same feelings for him. Then everything changes, when Count Adam Rodzinsky arrives to visit his sick uncle Witold. First, Anna is afraid of the older Adam. But then, she develops feelings for him, especially when they start to cross paths more and more frequently. Turns out, Adam was once married to a distant relative of Anna's, but the relationship ended in tragedy. Anna reminds him of his former beloved. Yet as their love blossoms, it remains forbidden.

title: Hrad z pisku
description: A mother and her daughter live alone far from human habitation. They are happy. Their harmonious relationship is interrupted by the unexpected arrival of a foreigner with his interpreter. In spite of the lack of verbal communication, the mother and the stranger fall in love, the daughter accepts him as well. The budding relationship is disturbed by the interpreter who realizes her power.

title: Malá z rybárny
description: Everyone's familiar with Hans Christian Andersen's The Little Mermaid, the story of a love capable of forgiving even the greatest betrayal. In Jan Balej's film - a work filled with wonderful animation, expressive puppet designs and an imaginative, shifting score from French composer Chapelier Fou - the fairy-tale romance is replaced with a bleak portrayal of life in a city harbor, yet its enduring message remains.

title: Project Z
description: At once a road-trip, detective story and zombie flick, Project Z tracks - behind the scenes and headlines - some of the most challenging global security issues of our times.

title: Wieloryb z Lorino
description: A film about the clash of two disappearing worlds; Chukchis civilization and the universe of monumental and majestic whales in a story about the paradox of history and a harsh fight for survival.

title: Gen Z
description: Gen Z is a series which portrays how the younger generation deals with life's struggles while striving to achieve their ambitions and its impact on their relationships with family and friends.

title: Pojdi z mano
description: In search of the best photo for the school competition, four teenagers head to remote hills. The competition for awards turns into a struggle for survival. Manc, who leads the group to remote but scenic countryside, where he spent his childhood with his grandpa, had been accused of stealing a phone and consequently might be expelled from school. Schoolmates Mina, Oto and Spurc join him on this trip. Mina, who is spoiled, stubborn city girl, breaks first in this foreign environment, but luckily by her side always stands Oto, rational boy who is in love with her. In this untouched nature which is such an unknown world to them also Spurc, who was golden-spoon-fed all his life, turns into a cowardish spoiled-child, and at the end Manc is again the one who safely guides them back home. A story about growing up, love, friendship and heroism. The warm but suspenseful and occasionally spine-chilling film focuses on what happens in the today's world when technology stops working and the 'primal' human instincts come to light.

title: Bravo Two Zero
description: This is the true story of the most highly decorated British patrol since the Boer war: an eight man SAS team inserted behind Iraqi lines during the Gulf War in January 1991. Their mission was to take out the scud missiles which Saddam Hussein was using to terrorize his enemies, as well as to sever strategic communication lines between Baghdad and North West Iraq. This top secret mission was called "Bravo Two Zero" and it was commanded by Sergeant Andy McNab. Of the eight who went out, only five returned. Dropped into "scud alley" carrying 210-pound packs, McNab and his men soon found themselves surrounded by Saddam's army. Their radios didn't work; the weather was brutally cold. And they had been spotted.

title: The Zero Hour
description: Twin sisters Fanny and Evelyn Craig are unaware that their stepfather, Micah Parrish, is a fake spiritualist until his lack of money forces them to return home from boarding school. Evelyn eagerly assists Parrish and his even more unscrupulous partner, Esau Brand, while Fanny, disgusted, leaves home to become lawyer Bruce Taunton's secretary. Following the death of his mother at a séance, Bruce vows to place the city's fake clairvoyants behind bars, but when Fanny is killed on the day she was to marry Bruce, he becomes unbalanced. Seeing an opportunity to stop the lawyer's crusade, Brand forces the reluctant Evelyn to appear to Bruce each evening as Fanny's spirit, but his threat of shooting himself so that he might join her causes her to reveal the deception. Brand finally is released, while Bruce finds consolation in Evelyn's love.

title: Lords of the Underworld

Instead of constantly going to war Rocky proposes a gladiatorial forum in which power is earned; respect won or lost, and disputes are resolved;..until death. "Gentlemen we have always lived by the sword, might is right. I propose that we set up a game to the death. A game of real power and strength. A game that centuries ago decided the fate of nations..." It's the fascinating story of a man, who has a vision to unify the Underworld. His past sins torment his very being. Guardians of the 'game', protectors from ancient times, offer their guidance, yet their motives are unknown. Rocky is put to the test facing a past love, a troubled daughter he never knew, the dark underworld syndicates challenging his power, and the onus that it exacts. And this is only the beginning.

title: Dead on Time [Hindi]
description: The 'Arab Spring of 2011' is in full eruption, turmoil consumes the Mid-East region as protesters, rebels and insurgents wreak havoc and destruction. A Clandestine American Military Agency, 'Black Halo', is forced to move a vital asset out of the warzone in Amrakistan. Mike McGuirk (Michael Madsen) sends in a Black-Ops team led by Segar (Michele Ghersi) to securely extract Moshin Dewar (Mohamed Zouaoui) and his newest invention. Moshin sensing something is not right, escapes Segar by jumping out of a flying plane. Using his device to survive, he literally falls into the clutches of a slave mining magnate, Anwar the Butcher (Benbadra Afif), now holding Moshin for trespassing on his land and destroying one of his vehicles. Segar fails in to negotiate with Anwar. McGuirk under extreme pressure from his superiors who fear he is losing control of the situation, switches to Plan B.

title: Valavaara [Kannada]
description: Amid the misty hills of Sakleshpur, Karnataka, Valavaara unfolds as a sweeping coming-of-age drama about brotherhood, loyalty, and the weight of responsibility. Kundeshi, a quiet boy from a struggling farming family, has always lived in the shadow of his younger brother, Kosudi - their father's clear favorite. When the boys take their pregnant cow out to graze, it vanishes into the countryside and tramples a neighbor's field, setting off a desperate search. With their father's return looming, Kundeshi must track down the animal before disaster strikes. His journey through rugged terrain and simmering family tensions forces him to confront his own insecurities and discover what it truly means to grow up. Lyrical and emotionally charged, Valavaara is a poignant portrait of rural childhood, responsibility, and the fragile bonds that hold families together.

title: Naate [Bengali]
description: Set against the rural backdrop of South Rajasthan, "Naate" is a social drama that explores the harsh realities of the ancient, controversial "Naata custom"—a practice where women are financially and socially traded or forced into relationships. The story follows Jeevvi, a mother who has been subjected to this cycle multiple times and fights daily for survival, and her daughter Pinky, who sacrifices her own dreams and accepts child marriage to protect her mother. It is an emotional and raw look at systemic social corruption, honor, and deep-seated prejudices targeting women in rural India.

title: Rampaat [Marathi]
description: We all dream differently. But there are some dreams that are larger - than - life, that have no limits and yet we continue to chase those dreams regardless of it's relativity to the real life. One of such larger - than - life dreams that have mesmerized countless youngsters today is the dream of 'Stardom'!. And In this age where everything is instant and fleeting the youth today expect the same from their dreams. They want it right away, super-fast viz. Rampaat !! Mumbai being the 'city of dreams' the youth from various villages, cities, every nook, and cranny in India arrive in Mumbai to pursue this dream. But is that all it takes? Or does it require immense dedication, hard work and seeking the right direction to achieve this dream? This is what Rampaat portrays. With the dream of Instant stardom, earning quick money and making their parents proud - Mithun from Solapur and Munni from Kolhapur come to Mumbai and that's when the bittersweet struggle of their journey to achieving their dreams begin. This amusing journey teaches them to work harder and hustle for an 'All time hit' rather than a 'One-time hit ' Telling the youth their own story in an upbeat manner along with rhythmic music, the fast-moving story does justice to its title. Rampaat is the 70 mm projection of and for the young ambitious dreamers today.

title: Blossom Through the Cloud
description: Ruan Sixian once dreamed of becoming a pilot, but her aspirations were crushed when Hengshi Airlines canceled their pilot training program. Further misunderstandings with Fu Mingyu, the airline's vice president, led her to resign and pursue pilot training elsewhere. Three years later, Ruan Sixian graduates at the top of her class, becoming a highly sought-after talent among major airlines. Fu Mingyu, seeking to introduce a new fleet of aircraft, personally visits the flight academy to recruit her. Despite their past misunderstandings and fierce competition from other companies, Fu Mingyu sets aside his pride and offers Ruan Sixian an attractive package to bring her on board. Ruan Sixian's stunning comeback impresses everyone but also reignites old rumors. She faces rigorous assessments, unexpected incidents, and even a temporary suspension. Meanwhile, Fu Mingyu encounters numerous challenges in his company's reform efforts. Amidst these trials, the two gradually develop mutual understanding and support, deepening their relationship. Together, they not only achieve personal growth but also reach new heights in their respective careers.

title: Blossoms of Power
description: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Qingzhi Gu awakens under a new identity as Xihe Shen, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Huayong Xiao, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

title: My Lethal Man [Hindi]
description: Because of an unexpected kidnapping case, Shen Man Ning discovers Zhuang Xin Yan. After Zhuang Xin Yan dies, the powerful and mysterious Yan Xing Cheng forces Shen Man Ning to start her "second life" as his fiancee. As they overcome adversities and difficulties together, the two go from being utterly hostile to one another to slowly joining hands, learning to love and rely on each other. Together they discover the truth of the unsolved case from 17 years ago.

title: Sniper Butterfly
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.

title: Anime fiammeggianti
description: Rosario, a roman high school teacher, has been left by his wife Elena who is now living with her sister Eugenia. He's very depressed and he's often visited by a very earthly Madonna. He wants his wife back but in the meantime he has to put up with his colleague Amalia and her friend Salvatore, a petty criminal recently out of jail, who falls in love with him. Rosario is thinking of becoming a criminal too. Elena is then kicked out by Eugenia, because a suitor of hers, Bussotti, has fallen in love with Elena. Rosario hopes for a reconciliation but his flat gradually becomes an open house as Salvatore and Bussotti spend most of their time there. One day a disagreement between Rosario and his headmaster ends up in a homicide. After a torrid night of love spent with Elena, Rosario leaves with Salvatore on a little airplane.

Doing so, something inside her changes and she does something unexpected…

title: Bogside Story
description: The photojournalist Fulvio Grimaldi, as the only Italian eyewitness, documented the peaceful march for civil rights through the Bogside in Derry on the 30th of January 1972 that ended with the tragedy known as Bloody Sunday, travels to Northern Ireland 45 years later to give evidence on the third inquiry about Bloody Sunday. In Derry, he discovers that the external walls of the houses located in Rossville Street are painted with the most important events of the 'Troubles' and the struggle for civil rights in the seventies. Grimaldi, fascinated by the communicative power of the murals, one of them inspired by his iconic photograph of Bloody Sunday, gets in touch with The Bogside Artists and the people who were involved in the events depicted on the murals. The meeting between Fulvio Grimaldi and The Bogside Artists leads to a journey through the past and the present full of history, arts and deep emotions.

title: Boxer's Story
description: Wah Sang was a boxing champion seven years ago. He now works at a garage and cares for his seven-year-old son Henry. They live a small apartment and Wah spends much of his time gambling and drinking. Henry wants Wah, whom he addresses by that name him to return to boxing, but Wah is hesitant because he suffered a brain injury. Henry is a go-kart racer, and at the track, Susan sees her friend Jenny, whose son is also in the race, being rude to him, so she approaches him and bets him dinner if he can win the race. Henry tries to pass Jenny's son in a curve and runs into the grass. When his crew come to aid him, she sees Wah, her ex-husband, there, and confronts him, demanding to know if Henry is their son. Thus begins Wah and Susan competing for Henry's affections, though Henry does not yet know that Susan is his mother. Susan is married to a cardiologist, and she has a successful career in car sales (particularly to white English-speakers). They live in a large house and believe they can give Henry a better life, while Wah descends further into gambling and risks losing his son when he attacks his creditors for trying to take his son. Wah suggests that Henry ought to live with Susan for a while, and when Henry refuses, Wah slaps him around for addressing him so informally in order to get him to leave. Henry calls Susan, who takes him in happily, but when she tells him that she is her mother, he is outraged because Wah told him that his mother died shortly after his birth. Wah admits to Henry that Susan is his mother, and that he still loves her, but couldn't deal with her continuing with her career, then contemplates returning to boxing to pay his debts, even though this means risking his life.

description: 20 years ago, the combining robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious invaders known as Aposdoll. title: Pop Life
description: Illicit drugs have been influential in pop music dating back to the days of Woodstock and beyond. Over time, street drugs like Molly, LSD, marijuana and crystal meth have been infused in live concerts, club venues, festivals, party scenes and music lyrics. Today's teens and young adults have grown desensitized to these popular street drugs, which calls into question the importance in raising awareness on the topic of illegal drug use. POP LIFE delves deep into the topic of popular street drugs in the music and party scenes, from college frat houses to raves, in order to get a first-hand dose of what exactly happens in these environments where drugs are exchanged, played and consumed openly and enthusiastically.

title: Boss [Hindi]
description: Abandoned at birth at the Kasturba Annarthalay by her father, Gangulal, due to her gender, Anuradha grows up, and feels rejected when she is by-passed for adoption. When she grows up, she becomes a social worker, coming to the assistance of needy people. Once while assisting an accident victim, she hitches a ride from the Managing Director of GK Constructions, Gaurav Khanna, who is impressed by her, hires her as his Personal Secretary, and also provides transportation as well as accommodation. Anuradha soon makes herself indispensable, and falls in love with him. He instead humiliates her several times forcing her to tender her resignation. Gaurav then advertises for a vacancy, hires a beautiful and smart woman, Shruti, and asks Anuradha to train her during her 30 day notice period. At the end of this period, Anuradha confesses her love to Gaurav and this is when she will find out that Gaurav is already married to Sanjana, whose parents, Sumitra and Vishwanath, live in Malaysia, and that Shruti has a secret agenda of her own.

title: The Boss Ladies
description: Four businesswomen, who met a year ago at a women's conference, decided to go on a spiritual cleansing retreat. All are graced with beauty, intelligence, passion, drive and an appeal that is undeniable to those around them. From the outside, it seems perfect and what every woman would want, but is it really? What drives these powerful women? Is there a darker dimension to their lives that most are not privy to see? Everyone has a secret. Some are bigger and darker than others, but they are there. When you mix the desire to get ahead at any cost with the ability to get anything done, things can happen. Bad things can happen or at least the types of things you never want to see the light of day. Hiding secrets often involve devious deeds, forming strange alliances, and nearly selling your soul. Take a journey through the lives of four of the most powerful and hungry women around. Discover how high the price can be to get to the top and what it takes to stay there. Who will win, who will lose, and who will be able to keep the darkness from coming to light? These four highly successful Boss Ladies' lives are anything except easy. First, there is the ruthless Mogul/Fashion Designer, Mya Weatherly, next, the timid Business Executive, Wendy Brinkley, followed by the secretive Entrepreneur, Chen Liang, and finally the sensuous Super Model/Restaurant Owner, Adriana Gomez. Each has perfect, powerful lives on the outside, but only because of the dark and devious moves underneath. Enemies are prone to disappear mysteriously, interested men are abundant and calling, and while good lovers are hard to come by, these ladies know that their friendship is one of the strongest assets they have. Each of them knows that their business is their heart, and they will stop at nothing to keep it beating. The lives of these powerful women will touch, and sparks will fly. There are lessons to be learned, alliances to be made, and moments of bonding that only others who walk a mile in the dark can understand. Be ready to experience how SHREWD these women are in business while on their retreat and the pack they all formed to protect, conquer, and annihilate anyone who is a threat. Welcome to the world of the FOUR BOSS LADIES.

title: Funeral Boss
description: When an entire family works each and every day around death, how does it affect the way they live their lives? How does in affect the way in which they view the world? At the William C. Harris Funeral Home in St. Louis, MO, helping people grieve, enabling people to celebrate, encouraging people to rejoice in the life of their recently deceased loved ones is an art, a science and a calling. Funeral Boss is a workplace documentary series centered around a compassionate but crazy family that hosts and services a steady flow of unique characters under crisis and in celebration. We will see first hand what it takes to run a thriving funeral home which also happens to be a multi-generational family business. Viewers will be inspired by the stories that center around the clients and will be entertained by the issues that arise amongst the family members within their day-to-day jobs.

title: Snake Boss
description: We meet Julia Baker, a pastry chef turned snake catcher in Brisbane, Australia. She is one of only a handful of female snake catchers on the entire continent. Julia and her partner Johnny Bagpipes are on a mission to help people understand snakes, instead of fearing them.

title: The Wrath of Vajra
description: Before the West entered World War II, a Japanese death cult called the Temple of Hades is ordered to aid in the spiritual destruction of China. Their method - abduct their enemies' children and train them as killers for the Emperor. Young Vajra was especially gifted, but swears a secret oath of revenge when his brother dies. Now the greatest assassin in the temple, Vajra escapes to China and begins his quest to protect the innocent, and destroy the ones responsible for making him a living weapon. A former Shaolin monk, martial arts action star Xing Yu (aka Shi Yanneng) stars as Vajra in his first leading role.

title: New World
description: Coco, a Beijing modern girl wants to spend a romantic and fancy Christmas vacation in Osaka. However the place where she gets in is Shinsekai( "New World" in English, is an old neighbourhood located next to south Osaka city's downtown "Minami " area, as known as one of the most poorest and dangerous area in Osaka.)When she arrives there, she starts feeling regret and frustrated by the encounters and the landscapes which are far beyond her expectation. Suddenly she is involved in an incident surrounds a Chinese family there, meanwhile she starts fascinated by Shinsekai through her wondering. In this short and unusual Christmas vacation, Coco discovers a "Japan " she never knows and a "China" that she is not familiar with .
